name: Festus
source:
Festus is a former priest who spends his time divided between serving the community and spending time with his friend, Anise. Festus is very cheerful and always cracking jokes, but is still (surprisingly?) good at giving advice. Of course, he always has to pepper the serious moments with a few jokes to dissipate the tension.

His relationship with Anise is inappropriate in the eyes of the Church, but Festus feels that his sexual activities have nothing to do with his abilities to serve the community. Whether or not the player agrees, the MC in Festus’ route will see the tension between Festus’ private and professional life.

[From strategy guide]
